app.name: Muamalat
app.footerNote: Muamalat is an internal service request and workflow platform.
app.prototypeNotice: Prototype build. All records shown are sample data and no submission is filed with any authority.

lang.loadFailed: The Arabic text could not be downloaded, so the interface is showing English. Check your connection and try switching again.

auth.signInIntro: Choose the account you want to use. This prototype does not connect to the national identity service, so no credentials are collected.
auth.roleHint: Each account opens a different part of the platform.

roles.citizenDescription: Submit requests and follow their progress.
roles.officerDescription: Work a queue of assigned cases and move them through the workflow.
roles.supervisorDescription: Monitor departmental workload, SLA performance and escalations.
roles.adminDescription: Design and version the workflows the whole platform runs on.

sla.label: Service level
sla.atRiskExplanation: Less than a quarter of the processing window remains.
sla.breachedExplanation: The statutory processing window has passed.

stage.submissionHint: The request is prepared and filed.
stage.reviewHint: An officer checks the documents and the application details.
stage.approvalHint: A supervisor confirms or refuses the decision.
stage.completionHint: The outcome is issued and the file is closed.

validation.summaryTitle: This form cannot be submitted yet
validation.pattern: {field} is not in the expected format.
validation.email: Enter an email address in the format name@example.com.
validation.phone: Enter a Kuwaiti mobile number, eight digits beginning with 5, 6 or 9.
validation.civilId: Enter the twelve digit civil ID printed on the card.
validation.date: Enter a date in the format day, month, year.
validation.dateFuture: {field} must be a date in the future.
validation.datePast: {field} must be a date in the past.
validation.fileTooLarge: {file} is {size} and the limit is {limit}. Attach a smaller copy.
validation.fileType: {file} is not an accepted format. Attach one of: {formats}.
validation.commentRequired: This action requires a comment explaining the decision.

errors.genericTitle: This section could not be loaded
errors.genericDescription: The request to the workflow service did not complete. Nothing has been changed. Try again, and if it keeps failing, quote reference {reference} to the service desk.
errors.networkTitle: No connection to the workflow service
errors.networkDescription: Your device is online but the workflow service did not respond. This is usually temporary. Try again in a moment.
errors.loadRequestsDescription: The case list did not come back from the workflow service. Your existing requests are unaffected. Try again, or clear the filters if you have just changed them.
errors.loadRequestTitle: This request could not be opened
errors.loadRequestDescription: The file could not be read from the workflow service. It has not been changed. Try again, or return to the list and open it from there.
errors.loadDashboardTitle: Dashboard figures could not be calculated
errors.loadDashboardDescription: The reporting service did not return the workload figures. No figures are shown rather than showing figures that may be wrong. Try again.
errors.loadServicesTitle: The service catalogue could not be loaded
errors.loadServicesDescription: The list of services did not come back from the catalogue, so there is nothing to choose from yet. Nothing you entered has been lost. Try again.
errors.loadWorkflowsTitle: Workflow definitions could not be loaded
errors.loadWorkflowsDescription: The definition store did not respond. Published workflows continue to run normally; only this editor is affected. Try again.
errors.notFoundDescription: The address you opened does not match anything in Muamalat. It may have been mistyped, or the item may have been removed.
errors.requestNotFoundDescription: There is no request with reference {reference} that you are permitted to see. Check the reference, or open it from your list.
errors.permissionDeniedTitle: You do not have access to this section
errors.permissionDeniedDescription: This area is reserved for the {required} role and you are signed in as {current}. If you need access, ask your department administrator to update your role.
errors.actionFailedDescription: The workflow service rejected the transition, so the request is still at its previous stage. Try again, and check that the required comment and documents are attached.

empty.noRequestsTitle: You have not submitted any requests
empty.noRequestsDescription: When you submit a request it appears here with its reference number and current stage.
empty.noFilteredRequestsDescription: Nothing in your list matches the current filters. Widen the date range or clear the filters to see everything again.
empty.noQueueDescription: There is nothing assigned to you that needs action. New cases appear here as soon as they are routed to your department.
empty.noResultsDescription: No records match "{term}". Check the spelling, or search by reference number instead.
empty.noDocumentsDescription: This request was filed without attachments. You can ask the applicant for a document using the more information action.
empty.noCommentsDescription: Comments recorded against this request are visible to everyone who handles it.
empty.noWorkflowsDescription: Nothing has been defined yet. Create a definition to describe how a service moves from submission to completion.
empty.noEscalationsDescription: No case has been raised to a supervisor in the selected period.
empty.noDataDescription: There is nothing recorded in the selected period, so no figures can be shown.

toast.requestSubmittedDetail: You can follow its progress from your request list.

a11y.chartDescription: Chart. The same figures are listed in the table below.

dialog.discardDescription: The details you have entered on this step will be lost. This cannot be undone.
dialog.leaveDescription: Your draft is saved, so you can return to it from your request list.

search.placeholder: Search by reference, service or applicant
search.label: Search requests

citizen.title: My requests
citizen.subtitle: Everything you have filed with the ministry, and where each file has reached.
citizen.progressDescription: Where this request has reached in the process.
citizen.historyDescription: Every action recorded against this request.
citizen.documentsDescription: Copies you attached when filing, and whether each has been checked.
citizen.actionNeededDescription: The reviewing officer has asked for more information. The request stays open while you respond.
citizen.responsePlaceholder: Describe what you are providing, and attach any documents that were asked for.

wizard.title: New request
wizard.serviceHint: Choose the service that matches what you need. The processing time and any fee are shown against each one.
wizard.detailsHint: These questions come from the selected service.
wizard.documentsHint: Attach a clear copy of each required document. Accepted formats and size limits are listed against each one.
wizard.reviewHint: Nothing is filed until you submit. You can go back to any step to change an answer.
wizard.contactPhoneHint: We send the reference number and any request for information to this number.
wizard.priorityHint: Urgent requests are reviewed first but the statutory processing time does not change.
wizard.declarationText: I confirm that the information given is correct and that the attached documents are genuine copies.
wizard.successDescription: Keep the reference number. You can follow the progress of this request from your list at any time.

officer.title: Work queue
officer.subtitle: Cases assigned to you and to your department, ordered by how close each one is to its deadline.
officer.documentsHint: Check each attachment against the original before advancing the case.
officer.rejectDocumentTitle: Why is this document being rejected?
officer.rejectDocumentHint: The applicant sees this note, so say exactly what is wrong and what is needed instead.
officer.actionsHint: These are the transitions the published workflow allows from the current stage for your role.
officer.noActionsDescription: The workflow does not allow your role to act on this case at its current stage. It is waiting on {role}.
officer.commentPlaceholder: Record what you checked and why you are taking this action.
officer.internalComment: Internal note, not shown to the applicant
officer.confirmActionDescription: This moves case {reference} to {state} and records the action against your name.
officer.documentsRequiredBlocked: Every required document has to be verified before this action becomes available.

supervisor.title: Oversight dashboard
supervisor.subtitle: Departmental workload, service level performance and where cases are getting stuck.
supervisor.kpiOpenHint: Cases that are not yet closed.
supervisor.kpiAtRiskHint: Open cases with less than a quarter of the processing window left.
supervisor.kpiBreachedHint: Open cases past the statutory processing window.
supervisor.kpiAverageHint: Mean time from submission to closure, closed cases only.
supervisor.kpiOnTimeRateHint: Share of closed cases that finished inside the processing window.
supervisor.kpiEscalationsHint: Cases raised to a supervisor in the period.
supervisor.workloadDescription: Open cases per department, split by service level status.
supervisor.bottleneckDescription: Mean time spent in each workflow state, longest first. These are the states to staff or simplify.
supervisor.throughputDescription: Cases submitted against cases closed, by week.
supervisor.escalationsDescription: Cases raised for a supervisor decision, oldest first.
supervisor.atRiskDescription: Open cases that are at risk or already past their deadline.
supervisor.noBreaches: No breached cases in this period.
supervisor.figuresNote: All figures are calculated from the records in the selected period.

admin.title: Workflow definitions
admin.subtitle: The state machines that every service request runs on. Published versions are immutable; changes are made in a draft.
admin.publishedNotice: This version is published and cannot be edited. Editing is disabled to protect the {count} cases currently running on it.
admin.publishedNoticeAction: Create a draft from this version
admin.canvasDescription: Each column is a stage. Arrows show the transitions a case can take.
admin.canvasHint: Select a state or a transition to edit it.

stateForm.keyHint: Stable identifier used by the engine and by existing cases. Lower case, no spaces.
stateForm.slaHoursHint: Working hours before the case counts against the service level. Leave empty for no limit.

transitionForm.allowedRoles: Roles allowed to take this action
transitionForm.guardHint: Expression the engine must evaluate to true before offering this action. Leave empty for no condition.

admin.deleteStateDescription: The {count} transitions connected to this state will be deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteStateBlocked: This state cannot be deleted because it is the start state. Add another start state first.
admin.deleteTransitionDescription: Cases will no longer be able to move from {from} to {to}.
admin.validationUnreachable: {name} cannot be reached from the start state.
admin.validationNoOutgoing: {name} is not an end state but has no outgoing transition, so a case would be stuck there.
admin.validationDuplicateKey: More than one state uses the key {key}.
admin.validationNoStart: The workflow has no start state.
admin.validationNoEnd: The workflow has no end state.
admin.validationClean: No problems found in this draft.

demo.title: Prototype controls
demo.description: This build runs on sample data held in the browser. These switches exist so the loading, empty and error states can be reviewed without a back end.
demo.failNextHint: Shows the error state that a real service outage would produce.
